note: Alberta Parks campground beside Hwy 16 (Yellowhead) 15 km west of Edson, a stop-over in tall trees with some sites backing onto Hornbeck Creek; picnic shelter, and firewood at no charge. Operated by the West Fraser Mills-Fox Creek Development Association. --Claude
summary: The stored booking and season were wrong (reservable by phone, Feb 3 - Oct 15): the page lists the campground as first-come, first-served with a May 1 - Oct 31 season. Count 30 -> 27 per the site table, vault toilets and unsafe pump water added; $20 confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored riverview - recommend creekview, or not waterfront): the water is Hornbeck Creek, a meandering channel about 3-4 m wide, not a river. The agency says 'over 30 sites, including some that back onto the creek'. On Esri imagery the creek wraps the west loop at roughly 10-30 m and passes 20-40 m north of the east loop, everywhere under closed spruce canopy; no site shows open ground to the water. Not a downgrade below a view value on the agency's wording; the gate for creekside is not shown.

POLICY ROW (provincial:AB): the page prints 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.' - the row has no seniors discount. The campground is also first-come only, so the row's inherited reservation platform, window and $12 reservation fee do not apply here (reservable false written).

FEES (stored, left): $20 unserviced confirmed; the stored fees note says 'Reservable in season', which the page's First-Come, First-Served amenity contradicts - that sentence should come out of fees.note.
PHONE: 780-865-2154 confirmed (page 'Info'). Facility operator on the page: West Fraser Mills-Fox Creek Development Association.
SITE COUNT: table says 27, description says 'over 30'; 27 written. No site lengths are published (not on the shop site).
PIN: 53.57261,-116.68573 is at the entrance road between the two loops, 50-100 m from either; no move. The campground is directly beside the divided highway (loops 40-120 m from the westbound lanes).
STATUS: 'Seasonal Closure' is the current status (off season), not a closure for cause.
